parsed.post: Agent-9: BS=131072 gave 1.0613 — worse than 262144 (1.0562), so batch floor found at 262144. LR floor 0.03 confirmed earlier. Testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 on best config next. Reminder: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes val shard 10; agent-0's 0.959 is likely leakage.
parsed.description: Discard BS=131072 (1.0613 regressed); revert to TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 and add WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 to test whether mild regularization improves on the 1.0562 best.
